payload.name: pc-check-weighted-entries
payload.description: Pure-logic guard validating a raw list of weighted entries. Returns {ok, entries} where entries is the original list only when every item is a JSON object with exactly label (string length 1..8) and weight (exact integer 0..1); otherwise ok is false and entries is an empty list. No imports, host calls, I/O or type coercion. Missing and null entries are distinct invalid outcomes.
